context: Tests full-body extraction, JSON output, the -p pitfall and the installation step for defuddle.

checklist.name: Checked whether defuddle is installed
checklist.description: The agent checks for the defuddle command before using it (for example with `which defuddle` or `defuddle --version`).

checklist.name: Installs with npm when missing
checklist.description: If defuddle is missing, the agent runs `npm install -g defuddle` rather than choosing another tool or skipping the step.

checklist.name: Used defuddle parse on the article URL
checklist.description: The agent runs `defuddle parse` with the article URL.

checklist.name: Used the --json flag
checklist.description: The command includes `--json` to get both the HTML and markdown in one result.

checklist.name: Used -o to write article.json
checklist.description: The agent writes the file with `-o article.json` rather than shell redirection.

checklist.name: Did not use shell redirection
checklist.description: The command contains no `>` redirect to create `article.json`.

checklist.name: Did not use -p for the body
checklist.description: The agent does not use `-p <name>`, which would return a single metadata property and drop the article body.

checklist.name: Did not use WebFetch first
checklist.description: The agent does not start with WebFetch for this standard article page.

checklist.name: article.json holds both formats
checklist.description: `article.json` exists and contains both an HTML field and a markdown field for the full article.

checklist.name: Tried defuddle before any fallback
checklist.description: If the agent mentions a fallback, it tries defuddle first and only falls back when the output is empty or navigation-only.
